portland-columbia-gorge-and-mount-hood.title: Portland · Columbia Gorge and Mount Hood
portland-columbia-gorge-and-mount-hood.slogan: Waterfalls, gorge wind and a mountain backdrop.
portland-columbia-gorge-and-mount-hood.story: Waterfalls, gorge wind and a mountain backdrop. 249 km round from Washougal - plan on about 4 h 47 of riding. The stops in between: Hood River and Sandy. The climb of the day is Mount Hood Timberline. It tops out at about 1,250 m. The passes are the reason to go.

sections.advice: Hood River food → Mount Hood Timberline is the reward section in Portland. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: This Mount Hood Timberline → Sandy return stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
